changes.text: Tweakr Black beta portal: license-gated pre-release builds and premium feedback.
Tweakr Grey beta portal: free accounts, experimental builds, bug reports.
Tweakr Grey v3.0 beta builds with experimental free features.
Strict one-license-per-email rule on purchase and coupons.
Clean URLs across the whole site (no more .html in the address bar).
Tweakr Grey v2.0 stable: Dashboard, TidySpace file sorter, System Cleaner, Startup Manager.
Tweakr Shield, System Fixes, and Monitor modules.
Faster script execution and UI alignment fixes.
Tweakr Black 0.1.0: first power-suite release with license activation.
Resolved floating activity log visibility issues.
